verdict.rationale: Metorial documents an OAuth flow for end users to authorize services like Slack and GitHub, and describes Portals as "branded places" where users connect integrations. Per-environment "authentication configs" are also mentioned, which hints that auth is configurable. Nothing in the pack shows supplying your own OAuth app client ID/secret or rebranding the OAuth consent/redirect flow itself. missing for 10: documented bring-your-own OAuth app credentials, white-labeling of the authorization/consent screens and redirect domain, details of what portal branding covers, independent corroboration.
